cards.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me

cards.arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
cards.text: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
Allah is kind and gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
Kindness is not found in anything except that it adds to its beauty, and it is not removed from anything except that it makes it defective.
Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity.
cards.ref: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 1956 (hasan per Darussalam; sahih per al-Albani)

cards.text: The merciful are shown mercy by Ar-Rahman. Be merciful on the earth, and you will be shown mercy from the One above the heavens.
cards.ref: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 1924 (hasan per Darussalam; sahih per al-Albani)

cards.text: By Allah, I ask forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day.
The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.
